_doc: World-watch state for the role-org MVP. See docs/architecture/ROLE_ORG_DESIGN.md. Updated by the /world-watch skill; the SessionStart hook only reads lastScan to decide if a scan is due. Cadence days: weekly=7, monthly=30, quarterly=90.

watch_signals: New/updated CVE or GitHub Advisory affecting a pinned dependency (freerasp, http_certificate_pinning, firebase_app_check, dio, http, crypto, flutter_onnxruntime) or any transitive Firebase/Dart pub package
freeRASP (Talsec) release: changes to root/jailbreak/Frida/hook/tamper detection thresholds, new attack-class coverage, or breaking callback API changes requiring re-review (cf. BUT-1218)
Firebase/GCP security bulletin or advisory touching Auth, App Check, Firestore/RTDB rules, Storage, or Cloud Functions (e.g. CVE-2025-0838-class fixes forcing a firebase_core bump)
New OWASP MASVS/MASTG/MASWE control, version bump, or test case that changes our mobile baseline (cert pinning, secure storage, anti-tampering, on-device-model integrity)
New mobile attack class or technique (Frida/Magisk bypass, emulator/bot evasion, instrumentation, model-extraction against on-device ONNX/CRF, TLS pin bypass) that defeats a current control
App Store Review Guideline or Google Play policy change with a security/privacy/data-sharing or target-API/permission deadline that gates a release

sources.name: OWASP Mobile Application Security (MASVS / MASTG / MASWE)
Google Play Console — Policy Announcements & Deadlines

watch_signals: App Store Review Guidelines revisions affecting UGC (1.2), age rating, privacy/data disclosure (5.1), AI-data consent, and external-link/payment rules
Google Play Developer Program Policy announcements: privacy/permissions, UGC moderation, news/magazine self-declaration, account/data deletion, billing & third-party store distribution deadlines
App Store / Google Play age-rating law and content-restriction mechanism changes (e.g. creator-content age gating, country-specific rating rollouts)
Konsumentverket / Marknadsföringslagen guidance on misleading marketing, hidden/influencer marketing in social media, environmental claims, and marketing to children
IMY (Swedish DPA) and EDPB GDPR guidance: DPIA requirements, breach-notification templates, lawful basis, AI/personal-data role allocation, AI Act market-surveillance role
Consumer & UGC liability: defamation / e-Commerce & DSA hosting-liability obligations for user-submitted recipes, ratings, and comments
Recipe/data-source licensing & ToS changes for any third-party recipe or ingredient data feeds the app ingests (copyright, attribution, scraping/AI-training terms)
EU Digital Services Act / consumer-law updates (e.g. omnibus directive, dark-patterns guidance) affecting in-app commerce and notice-and-action duties

sources.name: Google Play Policy Announcements (Play Console Help)
EU Digital Services Act – official text & guidance

watch_signals: New or revised Apple App Review Guideline sections (e.g. 4.3 low-value/spam, 1.2 age-rating/UGC, 5.1 privacy, 3.x business/IAP) that could trigger rejection of a recipe/pantry app
Apple Required Reason API / PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy manifest changes — new covered APIs, new SDK signature requirements, or enforcement dates that block app submission
Apple Developer Program License Agreement (DPLA) updates that must be accepted before the next release

Google Play Developer Program Policy changes with hard compliance deadlines (the Play policy deadlines timeline) — especially data/permissions, age-restricted content, account deletion, and target-API-level mandates
Google Play Data Safety form requirement changes — new data types, disclosure rules, or consistency-with-privacy-policy enforcement
Age-rating system changes (Apple's new age-rating tiers / questionnaire; Google Play / IARC content-rating updates) affecting the app's declared rating
Privacy-manifest / SDK privacy requirements for bundled third-party SDKs (Firebase, analytics, ONNX runtime deps) that must each ship their own manifest
App-store-driven privacy/consent UX norms (privacy nutrition labels, tracking-consent prompts, account-deletion entry points) — drifting expectations reviewers now enforce
Regional distribution rule changes (EU DMA / alternative distribution, Brazil, developer-verification mandates) that alter what must ship per market
